title: Chick in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='22' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='18' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='33' r='8' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- cheek left -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='5' fill='#FF9F43'/>
  <!-- cheek right -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='5' fill='#FF9F43'/>
  <!-- scarf wrap -->
  <path d='M30 52 Q50 60 70 52 L70 58 Q50 66 30 58 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M34 55 Q50 62 66 55' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M66 56 L72 70 L64 68 Z' fill='#E74C3C'/>
  <!-- scarf tail stripe -->
  <path d='M67 60 L70 67' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- eye left -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- eye right -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='36' r='3.5' fill='#2C3E50'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='35' r='1.2' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 42 L50 48 L54 42 Z' fill='#FF8C00'/>
  <!-- beak highlight -->
  <path d='M48 43 L50 46 L52 43 Z' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <!-- wing left -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='64' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(-15 27 64)'/>
  <!-- wing right -->
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='64' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#FFC300' transform='rotate(15 73 64)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M40 84 L36 92 M40 84 L40 93 M40 84 L44 92' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M60 84 L56 92 M60 84 L60 93 M60 84 L64 92' stroke='#FF8C00' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head tuft -->
  <path d='M47 21 Q50 14 53 21' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#FFC300' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M50 20 Q51 13 54 19' fill='#FFD93D' stroke='#FFC300' stroke-width='1.5'/>
</svg>
